Superhero Name Generator

Create superhero or supervillain codenames — adjective + noun combos with a matching superpower, hero or villain leaning.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose hero or villain leaning.
  2. Pick how many codenames to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then click any result to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What changes with the villain toggle?

Hero names use bright, bold word banks; villain names switch to dark, ominous banks with menace-themed powers.

Do names include powers?

Each codename comes with a suggested superpower like flight, telekinesis, or shadow manipulation.

How do I copy a result?

Click any codename or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
